long_biography.plain_text:
Epidemic Sound placed Winbladh at the junction of software and music licensing. As a co-founder, he helped establish a platform built around an intellectual-property-owned catalogue for creators and brands. After time away from its board, he returned as chair to guide product deployment and the company's expansion into AI-assisted soundtracking.

Winbladh carried his operating experience into venture capital as a founding partner of EQT Ventures. He left the firm in 2020 after backing early-stage technology businesses and now chairs CoFounded Kapital alongside entrepreneurs Jacob de Geer and Patrick Söderlund. The Stockholm company is registered for external fund and portfolio management; his associated FHW holding companies remain corporate vehicles, without public valuations of the underlying assets.
